tools.name: evaluate_hand
tools.description: Versioned optimized immediate score from bengine-core. Played and held order is optimized, not evaluated literally. Unsupported effects are rejected.

tools.name: recommend_action
tools.description: Exact small-deck mathematical action values under optimal continuation in the supported model, not estimated real-game success. Returns all optimal ties and fully reconciled draw explanations; no recommendation on incomplete jobs. No A2/full-deck sampling.

tools.name: compare_actions
tools.description: Compare all immediate plays or exact small-deck play/discard values, with the same contract and validation as HTTP. Exact mode limits: 12 draw cards, two hands, two discards. Select explain_actions for particular branches.

tools.name: get_solver_capabilities
tools.description: Engine/rules/build identity, contract version, supported effects, assumptions and limits.
